claims.claim: Binaural beats can be perceptually elicited by different ear-specific tones
claims.limitation: Auditory perception alone does not demonstrate efficacy

claims.claim: The 2023 EEG review included 14 studies: 5 consistent, 8 contradictory, 1 mixed
claims.limitation: Heterogeneity; counts not meta-analytic effect size

claims.claim: Binaural beats universally synchronize EEG activity
claims.limitation: Systematic review found inconsistent outcomes

claims.claim: The 2024 auditory review covered 31 studies with mixed or insufficient cognition/arousal links
claims.limitation: Not a brand trial

claims.claim: The mindfulness-app review covered 34 RCTs with 7566 participants
claims.limitation: Bias/heterogeneity, not product transfer

claims.claim: Zen12 specifically replicates all gains reported in mindfulness apps
claims.limitation: No product trial established

claims.claim: Zen12 Premium standard offer advertises 12 levels and 48 MP3s
claims.limitation: Not independently purchased or delivered

claims.claim: Zen12 offers different listening styles across levels
claims.limitation: Seller inventory

claims.claim: Zen12 produces the benefit of 60 minutes of meditation in 12
claims.limitation: No direct validated equivalence metric

claims.claim: A binaural EEG study validates Zen12 Premium
claims.limitation: Vendor product not tested

claims.claim: Zen12 promo /secret and standard /hnp have identical terms and cart totals
claims.limitation: Different seller propositions; exact cart unavailable

claims.claim: A displayed one-year seller refund statement proves fulfilled refunds
claims.limitation: No transaction or case evidence

claims.claim: Hypnosis Live Total Focus is a 33-minute advertised recording
claims.limitation: One distinct offer; not an efficacy result

claims.claim: Total Focus produces 100% concentration and reprograms the brain
claims.limitation: No adequate product-specific evidence

claims.claim: Total Focus price is stable across indexed and actual pages
claims.limitation: Conflicting captured price observations; checkout unknown

claims.claim: Brainwave Shots has product-specific clinically proven concentration outcomes
claims.limitation: Catalog claim does not supply clinical proof

claims.claim: Meditation and relaxation activities are necessarily risk-free
claims.limitation: Adverse effects have been documented

claims.claim: Product health claims require competent reliable relevant evidence
claims.limitation: Use independent product-specific support before repeating

claims.claim: A general affiliate disclosure page is sufficient regardless of link placement
claims.limitation: Disclosure near endorsement/link

claims.claim: The existing Fieldbook is free and available on published landing page
claims.limitation: Delivery and confirmed subscribers not independently tested

claims.claim: Historical Puységur reports establish modern brainwave audio benefits
claims.limitation: Historical source criticism, no mechanistic proof

claims.claim: Final Vestige is an authorized Inspire3 publishing affiliate
claims.limitation: Requires account-issued acceptance, terms, earning URL

claims.claim: A paid affiliate sale is established by outbound_click
claims.limitation: Independent settled merchant record required

claims.claim: A paid FV Mind product is authenticated as rights-cleared and fulfillable
claims.limitation: No verified SKU, checkout or entitlement

claims.claim: The optional R268 B media is hosted and playable
claims.limitation: Static poster/caption concept; film remains separate

claims.claim: Free Fieldbook signup and publication prove paid purchase
claims.limitation: Lead versus sale must be distinct

claims.claim: Participants sometimes explained an outcome that did not match their earlier selection in the 2005 controlled face-pair task
claims.limitation: Experimental covert swap, not a general percentage of consumers or long-term preference conversion

claims.claim: In 2010 jam and tea marketplace tests no more than a third of manipulated trials were detected overall
claims.limitation: Trial-level in the sampled supermarket manipulation, not a population prevalence

claims.claim: The 2012 self-transforming moral survey reported 69 percent failed to detect at least one of two manipulated reversals
claims.limitation: Not probability of permanent persuasion or sales conversion

claims.claim: Choice blindness shows all buyers can be manipulated into purchases
claims.limitation: Experimental choice reversals do not quantify retail paid conversion

claims.claim: A coherent stated preference necessarily preserves the exact decision process that produced the original choice
claims.limitation: Verbal reports may be reconstruction; avoid claim that introspection is always wrong

claims.claim: Puységur's historical files prove Zen12 or hypnosis audio mechanisms
claims.limitation: Historical testimonies do not validate contemporary branded health claims

claims.claim: The R268 B poster-and-transcript preview is equivalent to a tested user-playable 42-second film
claims.limitation: Static transcript and poster; film remains a separate, unhosted review artifact

claims.claim: A publisher-issued Final Vestige Inspire3 authorization and payable revenue are established
claims.limitation: Public merchant pages and promotional mail do not prove acceptance, permission or settlement
